question: Which of the following was the capital of the Hindu Shahi kingdom?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Waihind**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Waihind:-**

 
 
• It was the capital of the Hindu Shahi kingdom, which existed from the 7th to the 11th century in the region of present-day Afghanistan and Pakistan.
 
• The kingdom was founded by the Turkic Shahi dynasty, who were originally from Central Asia.
 
 
 
• Hindu
